label: Keybindings
description: Bifrost's keyboard shortcuts, written to ~/.config/bifrost/hypr/bifrost.lua and applied live. A key Bifrost binds is unbound first, so it never runs twice.

settings.label: Bifrost keybindings
settings.description: Off = Bifrost binds no keys at all

settings.label: Terminal
settings.description: Command for Super+T. Empty = the system default (xdg-terminal-exec, $TERMINAL, then an installed terminal)

settings.label: Super + number
settings.description: Shows workspace N (Shift moves the window), or moves the window there and follows (Alt only shows)

settings.label: Bifrost
settings.description: Launcher (Super+Space), Settings, notifications, power menu, lock, terminal

settings.label: Screenshots
settings.description: Print = area, Ctrl+Print = screen, Alt+Print = window

settings.label: Window management
settings.description: Close, maximize, float, focus and move with Super + arrows

settings.label: Workspaces
settings.description: Super + number, Super + scroll, Super + Page Up/Down

settings.label: Own keybindings
settings.description: One per line: 'SUPER + X: ipc controlcenter toggle', '…: run command' or '…: dispatch hl.dsp.…'. Replaces a default on the same keys

settings.label: Disabled keys
settings.description: Key combinations Bifrost should leave unbound, e.g. 'SUPER + Q'

settings.label: Changed shortcuts
settings.description: Bifrost shortcuts moved to other keys, by id; an empty value turns one off. Edited on the Shortcuts page
